_comment: prevent_self_review is false on purpose. This repo has one maintainer;
GitHub will not let a user approve their own deployment, so true would
make the prd gate permanently unsatisfiable.
deployment_branch_policy is null (any branch may deploy) until the main
ruleset is enforcing. Setting protected_branches:true before then would
block every deployment, because no branch is protected yet.
secrets are empty because a declared-but-absent secret is a hard failure:
the API cannot create one without a value. Add AZURE_CLIENT_ID here once
